newsitem.title: UK: Easier US cotton futures spur European mill inquir.
newsitem.headline: Easier US cotton futures spur European mill inquir.

text.p: A modest upturn in mill inquiry for raw cotton was prompted by the further decline of New York futures and related lowering of asking rates for certain origins.
But on most European raw cotton markets there was little sign that spinners were ready to depart from a hand-to-mouth buying policy.
The absence of a more positive approach toward forward covering has surprised some traders since the continuity of supply over the next few months, for at least some origins, seems less than assured.
The customary Central Asian styles remained the focus of mill demand but the volume of new business was probably fairly limited.
